Container.Name: breeze-lora-server-cpu
Container.Overview: OpenAI-compatible HTTP server for Breeze TTS 2 with LoRA adapter hot-swap (CPU). Mount a models directory that contains server.json (backend: cpu), the Breeze-TTS-2-GGUF package, and any LoRA adapter directories. Relative paths in server.json resolve against that directory. CPU generation is slow; prefer the CUDA template for real traffic.
Container.Requires: Host path must contain server.json with "backend": "cpu", plus Breeze-TTS-2-GGUF and any LoRA adapters referenced by that config.

Config.Name: Models
Config.Description: Read-only host directory containing server.json, Breeze-TTS-2-GGUF/, and loras/. Config is loaded from /models/server.json so relative paths resolve inside this mount.
